config.revision: M: floating-head motion and load integration
config.status: Packaging and mechanism requirements; not fabrication CAD or a purchase release
config.assumptions: Head spring rates and parasitic/suction forces are design sensitivities, not measured limits. Plane-following is an ideal mechanism requirement; guide friction, force moments, brush compression and floor steps are not solved.
config.mass_policy: Retain K complete hardware allowances and existing mop lift. Add M mounts/risers and vacuum lift without claiming savings from old suspension allowances. Resolve all head-part mass as moving; partition added mount mass. I geometry changes placement, not catalog mass substitution. These remain conservative planning totals.
config.actuator_note: Existing 20 mm stroke, 19 g actuator reference; 62 g installed lift allowance. 16 mm head lift is a linkage requirement, not a verified stroke/load/speed fit. Spring unloading and mechanical raised retention remain to detail.
